features.name: Expanded Spell List
features.description:
Animal Lords add spells to your warlock spell list based on your patron's affinity:

| Spell Level | Animal Lord Spells | Air | Earth | Water |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1st | speak with animals | thunderwave | longstrider | fog cloud |
| 2nd | mark prey | gust of wind | pass without trace | misty step |
| 3rd | conjure animals | fly | phantom seed | water breathing |
| 4th | polymorph | storm of wings | sudden stampede | control water |
| 5th | commune with nature | insect plague | hold monster | cloudkill |

features.name: Natural Blessing
features.description: Starting at 1st level, you learn the *druidcraft* cantrip and gain proficiency in Animal Handling.

features.name: Animalistic Insight
features.description:
At 1st level, as an action, analyze one creature within 30 ft and share information with up to proficiency bonus creatures within 30 ft. Each gains one benefit (your choice) for 1 minute or until the creature dies:

* +1 to attack rolls against it.
* +1 to damage rolls when hitting it.
* Advantage on saves vs its spells and effects.
* +1 to AC when it attacks you.

1/short or long rest. At 10th level, each +1 becomes +2.

payload.name: Animalistic Insight
payload.description: Analyze a creature within 30 ft: grant up to prof bonus allies a combat benefit vs that creature for 1 min.

features.name: Patron Companion
features.description: At 6th level, your patron sends a beast companion of your patron's type (CR 1/4 or lower). It is friendly, speaks with you, obeys commands, shares your initiative, acts after yours. Direct as bonus action (Attack, Dash, Disengage, Help, Hide, Search). Dodges otherwise. If it dies, your patron sends a new one after 24 hours.

features.name: Primal Mastery
features.description:
At 10th level, choose one benefit per long rest (lasts until next rest):

**Cat Eyes.** Darkvision 60 ft (+30 ft if already have it).
**Chameleonic.** Advantage on Stealth checks.
**Fangs.** Natural weapon: 1d6 + CHA piercing (use CHA for attack).
**Hold Breath.** Hold breath 10 minutes.
**Keen Senses.** Advantage on Perception (hearing/smell).
**Leap.** Jump distance doubled.
**Spry.** Advantage on Acrobatics.
**Swift.** Speed +10 ft.
**Thick Hide.** +1 AC.
**Webbed Limbs.** Swim speed 20 ft.

features.name: Call the Legions
features.description: At 14th level, as an action, summon beasts of your patron's type as per a 7th-level *conjure animals* spell (no concentration required). 1/short or long rest.

payload.name: Call the Legions
payload.description: Summon beasts of your patron's type (7th-level conjure animals, no concentration) in unoccupied spaces within 60 ft.
